description: Allowed-input manifest binding whose inputs_manifest_hash does not match the SHA-256 of the referenced allowed-inputs file. The validator MUST reject this with ALLOWED_INPUTS_HASH_MISMATCH; a forged binding is functionally equivalent to a missing one.

allowed_inputs_record.description: A manifest whose inputs_manifest_hash claims to bind the allowed-inputs file but the value is the wrong 64-zero string. The Phase 0 retry validator MUST detect this mismatch and fail closed.
